verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a mechanism for passing dynamic variables or per-caller context into a Pipecat session at call time. Telephony webhooks, the development runner and Flows functions are related features, but none is shown to personalize a conversation with call-time data. The axis clearly applies to a voice-agent framework, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
